Buy cover
Connect a wallet to buy this cover.
What happens when you press Buy: the page re-reads the contract's own quote and re-checks the destination's deployed module, then your wallet asks you to approve a single buy_cover call with exactly that premium attached, sent to the address shown above. If you decline, nothing happens. If the contract refuses (capacity, bounds, pause), you see the contract's own reason and no policy is created.
